subject: Confusing erroer when access array out of bound?

messages.author: e1c430550f86b1f6
messages.subject: Confusing erroer when access array out of bound?
parts:
Hi all,

While I was debugging my code, i found that when access array out of bound in v2.15, instead of complaining array out of bound, Stan gives the error message:

Rejecting initial value:
  Error evaluating the log probability at the initial value.


Code:
data {
  int N_p;         
  int N_d_target;
}

parameters {
  vector[N_d_target] x[N_p];
}

model {
  {
    vector[N_d_target] x_fwd[N_p];

    // this should read: for (p in 1:N_p) {
    for (p in 1:N_d_target) {
      x_fwd[p] = x[p];
    }

  }

  for (p in 1:N_p) {
    x[p] ~ normal (0, 1);
  }
}

Data: N_p = 5, N_d_target = 20

With this setup, we have N_d_target > N_p. Hence, iterating over 1:N_d_target should cause out of bound access for array x and x_fwd

Maybe I am wrong. But, I thought, in the past, Stan would complain about array index out of bound?

Cheers,
Andy

We're working on fixing this. There's been an issue filed
against CmdStan and Stan and comments about RStan, but the
issue is in Stan itself. We'll probably be rolling out a patch
release for some of these R 3.4 / Stan 2.15 issues --- we changed
a lot under the hood in 2.15 and so did R with 3.4.

- Bob
